items.q: Where is the eBuddha Digitech office?
items.a: P-18, 3rd Floor, Liberty Plaza, Chetak Bridge, Zone-I, Maharana Pratap Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh 462011. Use the Get directions button on this page.

items.q: How can I reach you quickly?
items.a: Call or WhatsApp +91 84619 58162, or email ebuddhadigitech@gmail.com. The enquiry form below also reaches our team.

items.q: Do I need an appointment to visit?
items.a: It is best to message us first, so a counsellor is free to show you the classroom and answer your questions.

items.q: How do I book a free class or demo?
items.a: Use the Book a free class button or send your details through the form, and we will confirm the next available session.

items.q: How do I get the course fees and batch dates?
items.a: Share your details on the form or WhatsApp us. Our team replies with the syllabus, fees, EMI options and the next batch date.

items.q: Can I join the course online?
items.a: Yes. The online digital marketing course runs live with recordings, and you can also visit the Bhopal campus for classroom batches.

items.q: How do I ask about SEO, ads, social media or a website?
items.a: Tell us your business and goal through the form. We quote after a first conversation. See our services.

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside Bhopal?
items.a: Yes. We work with businesses across India and abroad, and calls, reviews and reports all run remotely.

items.q: Who do I contact for a certificate problem?
items.a: Check the number on our Verify Certificate page first, and message us if something does not match.

items.q: Are there jobs or internships at eBuddha Digitech?
items.a: Use the Explore Careers button on this page to see how to apply, or write to ebuddhadigitech@gmail.com.
